_note: Align Orthopedic & Wellness, the founder's practice and the free launch pilot. Working assumptions marked in docs/pilot-align.md; correct them here, then run npm run pilot:setup.
bio:
Orthopedic care for joints, bones, muscles and sports injuries: knees, shoulders, hips, back, hands and feet. Video visits now for patients located in Maryland. Our Columbia clinic opens January 1, 2027.

First visits cover your history, an exam (in person) or a guided movement check (by video), and a written plan you leave with: next steps, imaging if needed, and when to follow up.
